:::{#thm-expected-error-epe}
#### The expected generalization error averages the loss at each covariate value

If the random [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is independent of the new observation $(\newpredvar, \newoutvar)$,
the [expected generalization error](#def-expected-generalization-error)
of a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $\fitproc$
is the mean of its [expected prediction loss at $\predvar$](#def-epl)
over the distribution of $\newpredvar$:

$$
\expgenerr{\fitproc}{\nobs} = \E{\epl{\fitproc}{\nobs}{\newpredvar}}.
$$ {#eq-expected-error-epe}

:::

::: proof
This is @sol-expected-error-epe. <!-- check-solution-citations: allow -->
:::
